summary: Cayson Acquisition Corp, a Nasdaq-listed Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting that on September 23, 2026 shareholders approved a special resolution amending its memorandum and articles to extend the deadline to consummate an initial business combination. Concurrently, CEO Yawei Cao loaned the company $60,000 under a non-interest-bearing promissory note, deposited into the IPO trust account; principal is repayable in full only upon consummation of a Business Combination. The filing is a routine SPAC charter extension, not a signed deal: no target, price, premium, or merger terms were disclosed. Watch for redemptions, further monthly extensions, and any definitive business combination agreement.
